note: Weekly strength of matchup, 2026. defenses[D][pos] is what defense D has allowed per game to that position this season: ppr = PPR fantasy points, rec = receptions, so half = ppr - 0.5*rec, std = ppr - rec and TE-premium = ppr + bonus*rec (TEs only). rank.<scoring> is 1 = most points allowed = softest matchup for the offense, among defenses that have played. prior is the same ledger for 2025. factor is the StatHead model multiplier the weekly projections apply for that opponent (prior season blended with this one, shrunk toward 1, clamped) and factorRank ranks it the same way; it is the regressed view, the raw ledger is the loud one. schedule[T] lists every game for team T with the opponent, venue, whether it is final and the opponent's factor per position; byes are the missing weeks. Season to date means every final game, including the finished games of a week in progress. Computed by StatHead from nflverse weekly stats. oe = points allowed per game OVER EXPECTED: the offense faced is expected to score what it scores in its other games this season (leave-one-out; league average when it has none), so oe is the schedule-adjusted ledger; oeRec is the same for receptions so oe converts to other scorings; oeRank is 1 = most over expected. metrics[m] = {pg, oe, rank, oeRank} per component metric (see metricLabels); rates (ypc, ypr) are totals over totals and their expectation applies the offense's other-games rate to the volume it had in the game. ros[T][pos] averages the remaining opponents (from currentWeek, unplayed): ppr, rec, oe, factor, playoff weeks 15-17, with ranks 1 = softest rest of schedule.

grades.noise: slope < 0.10 (rank stability r where no player test)

reliability.note: From the 2016-2025 backtest at 6 weeks played. r = Spearman rank stability of the raw ledger (weeks 1..6 vs the rest of the season); rOE the same for over-expected; rBlend the weekly projections' prior+current blend (points only). slope = the fraction of a defense's deviation that showed up in the players facing it the rest of the season (1 = take the ledger at face value); soft8 / tough8 = a player's points against a top-8 / bottom-8 defense as a share of his own average. Rates and TD counts have no player test.
